questions: What is work?
If the work is done, did anything necessarily move?
What is a peak?
Once you reach the peak, is the only way down?
What is a cycle?
When the cycle ends, do you start exactly where you began?
What is overload?
If the overload continues, does it automatically shut down?
What is fatigue?
If fatigue disappears after a break, are you fully restored?
What is pace?
If the pace drops, are you necessarily slowing down?
What is activation?
Once activation happens, does it stay on?
What is form?
If the form is wrong, is it automatically invalid?
What is load?
If the load gets lighter, is it always easier?
What is power?
If the power drops, are you necessarily getting weaker?
What is volume?
If the volume rises, does it necessarily get louder?
What is alignment?
If the alignment is off, will it always pull to one side?
What is drive?
When the drive ends, do you stop moving?
What is recovery?
If recovery is complete, are you exactly back where you started?
What is follow-through?
If the follow-through is cut short, did the attempt fail?
